$comment: Judgement data for tools/gen_readiness.py -> out/factory/readiness.json + out/factory/readiness.html. Every NUMBER on the page is computed by the generator from out/factory/measure/*.json and the repo's own data files; this file holds only the things a measurement cannot produce: who owns each open parcel tonight, the bilingual labels, and the list of steps in the manual that assume knowledge not on the page (read as a stranger, 2026-09-03).

doc.title: Readiness audit
doc.sub: Artifact by artifact: can a factory that has never seen this repository build from this file today? READY TO BUILD FROM or NOT YET, with the measurement behind each grade, and for every NOT YET, what is missing and whether an agent closes it tonight or a person must.
doc.sub_zh: 逐个文件审核：一家从未见过本仓库的工厂，今天能否直接按此文件制造？每项给出“可直接制造”或“尚未就绪”，附测量依据；对每个“尚未就绪”项，说明缺什么、今晚由软件代理完成还是必须由人完成。

manual_assumptions.assumes: Every M2 count is community hole-fitting and the page says so; no screw LENGTH is given for any hole, so the line cannot kit a screw bag from this page.
manual_assumptions.by: WF-FASTENERS

manual_assumptions.step: Preamble: 'production may tap the plastic — CANNOT DETERMINE'
manual_assumptions.assumes: Whether each threaded hole gets a heat-set insert or a tapped thread is undecided; the reader must choose.
manual_assumptions.by: design decision (Leif / partner) after the coupon test in PLAYBOOK §5.3

manual_assumptions.step: 1.2 'bolt both XL330s hanging from trunk_base, horn axes through world (6, ±17.5, 115)'
manual_assumptions.assumes: The world frame is the MJCF's; there is no datum on any drawing to measure (6, ±17.5, 115) from, and which of the servo's 4+8 holes are used is not stated.
manual_assumptions.by: WF-FASTENERS (hole-to-screw map) + WF-SHEETS (datums on the sheet)

manual_assumptions.assumes: Insert part number, installation temperature and depth are not on the page (B18c names a candidate insert; no process).
manual_assumptions.by: factory process engineer writes the insert procedure on the first parts

manual_assumptions.step: 1.4 banana contact PCB onto Ø3.9 pins
manual_assumptions.assumes: Board polarity/orientation and which face meets the battery are not stated; the spring contact has no part number (P3).
manual_assumptions.by: teardown of a real pack + contact-part selection

manual_assumptions.step: 2.3 'Fix yaw2roll to the hip-yaw servo horn (spline)'
manual_assumptions.assumes: Which horn (ROBOTIS ships the XL330 with an idler and a horn), the horn screw count and the horn-zero index are only in PLAYBOOK §5.1/§5.3, not on this page.
manual_assumptions.by: WF-FASTENERS + manual regeneration

manual_assumptions.assumes: Left/right handedness of the hip bracket and which face is the horn side are not illustrated.
manual_assumptions.by: WF-POSE (per-joint pictures) / WF-HARNESS per-joint dossier

manual_assumptions.step: 3.4 'Hang the upper leg on the hip bracket: horn side to the hip-pitch servo'
manual_assumptions.assumes: No picture of the thigh's horn side; the servo cavity orientation is described in words only.
manual_assumptions.by: WF-HARNESS per-joint dossier

manual_assumptions.step: 3.7 'fit the TPU sole onto the foot'
manual_assumptions.assumes: Press-fit vs adhesive is not stated; connection:press-fit-sole-foot exists but its interference is not on the page.
manual_assumptions.by: manual regeneration from the connection record

manual_assumptions.step: 4.3 'Bolt the ID-30 servo to the trunk'
manual_assumptions.assumes: Which trunk part (trunk_base or power_support) and which holes are not named.
manual_assumptions.by: WF-FASTENERS

manual_assumptions.step: 5.6 'screw the M12 lens holder to the IMX219 board (3 × M2)'
manual_assumptions.assumes: The holder is bought-or-printed CANNOT DETERMINE (PARTS row 27); lens thread-in depth / focus procedure absent.
manual_assumptions.by: factory buys a standard M12 holder and sets focus on the first unit

manual_assumptions.assumes: No fixing method (screw / adhesive / clip) for any of the three; speaker and microphone part numbers are CANNOT DETERMINE (B12, B13).
manual_assumptions.by: teardown of a shipped unit or Pollen's answer

manual_assumptions.assumes: Shell screw positions, the order of closing and whether the trunk shells attach to trunk_base or to each other are not stated.
manual_assumptions.by: WF-FASTENERS

manual_assumptions.assumes: Cable lengths are route floors rounded to 5 mm with no tolerance; JST EH pin-1 orientation and cable retention (ties/clips) not stated; 6 of 23 rows carry a CANNOT DETERMINE.
manual_assumptions.by: WF-HARNESS; the tolerance needs the first physical loom

manual_assumptions.assumes: Which tool, which software image to flash on the Radxa and how to install it are not on the page (TEST-PLAN names robotctl; MANUAL does not say where it comes from).
manual_assumptions.by: manual regeneration citing software/upstream.json + install steps

manual_assumptions.assumes: No torque value for any of the three screw joints (PLAYBOOK §5.3 CANNOT DETERMINE).
manual_assumptions.by: strip / pull-out coupon test on the production print profile

manual_assumptions.assumes: Interference at every printed bearing seat is not specified anywhere (PLAYBOOK open item 3); the seat is modelled at nominal.
manual_assumptions.by: measure five printed seats per part on the production printer and set the interference

manual_assumptions.assumes: Every position is an MJCF body-frame number; the page never says which physical face is the frame origin, so nothing can be checked with a caliper.
manual_assumptions.by: WF-SHEETS (datums)

manual_assumptions.assumes: The pack is named NP-F550 in the text while the geometry the cradle was measured from is Pollen's np_f970 mesh (38.600 x 20.600 x 70.800 mm, COMPARISON.html finding 2 / GOAL.md); the page never states which physical cell fits power_support, so a stranger can buy the wrong pack.
manual_assumptions.by: measure the cradle against a purchased NP-F550 and an NP-F970, or Pollen's answer (sourcing line B7)

manual_assumptions.assumes: The page never says whether the right-hand parts are geometric mirrors, the same part reused, or distinct prints; bodies hip_l and hip_l_2 share a name stem while the print folder ships separate -left/-right STLs for some parts and one part for others.
manual_assumptions.by: manual regeneration from the assembly's own placements (mirror flag per placement)

manual_assumptions.step: 3 parts list 'microduck-upper-leg x1, microduck-ankle x1, microduck-foot x1'
manual_assumptions.assumes: The names carry no -left/-right suffix, but out/print/stl ships microduck-upper-leg-left/-right, -ankle-left/-right, -foot-left/-right and -sole-left/-right; a kitting operator cannot pull the bag by filename from this page.
manual_assumptions.by: manual regeneration from out/print/slice.json slugs

manual_assumptions.assumes: No step has an in-process inspection or an acceptance criterion, so a station cannot pass or fail its own work before the unit moves on (the gates in TEST-PLAN.html all run after full assembly).
manual_assumptions.by: per-station gate written from the TEST-PLAN gates that could be pulled earlier

manual_assumptions.assumes: No tool list: the M2 screw HEAD type and driver size are never named (Phillips / hex / Torx), nor the arbor press or socket size for the bearing presses, nor whether a soldering iron is needed for inserts.
manual_assumptions.by: WF-FASTENERS names the head type with the screw; the press tooling is already printed (out/print jig-press-15/22 STLs) but is not referenced from the manual

robot-hat.design_status: CORRECTED 2026-09-04 by a measurement taken in this repo tonight: Pollen DO publish a Robot HAT — github.com/pollen-robotics/elec_RPI_Robot_HAT, Apache-2.0, tree 23eab11927f95ceca0dfa35bf182caeb7db39ea0, with KiCad 9 source (elec_RPI_Robot_HAT.kicad_sch 961 620 B, .kicad_pcb 2 213 353 B) AND a complete production/ folder (Gerber zip 323 691 B, BOM, POS, SCH.pdf, STEP.zip). Apache-2.0 permits manufacture, modification and SALE. It is NOT proven to be the board inside the retail unit: the published outline is 65.0 x 48.5 x 1.0 mm, 4-layer, no mounting holes, while this repo's mesh is 65 x 30 x 0.84 mm with 4 holes — same design family, different revision (CANNOT DETERMINE). The Gerbers in electronics/robot-hat/ are still OUR footprint-accurate reconstruction, and they still FAIL DRC.
robot-hat.what: DECIDE FIRST, before any routing work: adopt Pollen's published Apache-2.0 package (fab it as-is and fit the 65.0 x 48.5 outline to the head, which the current motor_support does not accept) or keep our 65 x 30 reconstruction and re-route its 8 open nets to >= 0.1524 mm track. Evidence and licence reading: out/factory/licence.json fact F11, archived out/factory/licence-evidence/github-api_elec_RPI_Robot_HAT.json.

imu-to-dxl.design_status: Unpublished by Pollen; MCU choice (STM32G031F6P6) and firmware are OURS, firmware not written.
imu-to-dxl.what: route the 13 open connections; write the Protocol-2 slave firmware; then fab.

banana-contact.design_status: Passive strip; artwork complete and routed 3 of 3.
banana-contact.what: the spring-contact part has no part number and the contact pitch is derived, not measured; a caliper on a real NP-F550 pack and a contact selection settle it; JLCPCB accepts the 4.6 mm board with ENIG.

licence.en: 22 of the 30 print STLs are Pollen's simulation meshes, licensed CC BY-SA-NC (microduck_rl README §License: '3D model files are licensed under Creative Commons BY-SA-NC'). They may be printed for prototypes; they may NOT be sold. Only the 8 parametric rebuilds are ours. Pollen's mechanical CAD, BOM and PCBs are not published (SPEC.md:24).
licence.zh: 30 个打印 STL 中有 22 个是 Pollen 的仿真网格，许可证为 CC BY-SA-NC（microduck_rl README §License）。可用于打印样机，不可用于销售。仅 8 个参数化重建件为我方自有。Pollen 的机械 CAD、BOM 和 PCB 未公开（SPEC.md:24）。
